AssemblyAI Captions

A transcription scaffold for producing timed words, captions, and narration alignment metadata.

Installable integration scaffold

This manifest can be installed, locked, and evaluated today. Execution remains blocked until its reviewed adapter ships, so a scaffold never silently runs incomplete code.

Capabilities

transcriptioncaptions

Install

npx lazy plugin install assemblyai-captions -p <project>
